correctness.rationale: The frozen differential calculation and stated van Vleck term are correct in that convention. The repair names the convention in the Finding and makes the comparison to the cited stroboscopic statement in its own gauge. Independent re-audit: the two first harmonics εB/2 contribute exactly ε²[B,[A,B]]/(4ω²); the ±2 harmonics and the three-nonzero-harmonic sum cannot contribute at this amplitude degree. On the common smooth core the principal part of [A,B] is 4g''D², and commuting bD with aD² gives ba'−2ab' at order two. This yields a₂=8(2(g'')²−g'g'''); integrating gives 24∫(g'')², so real smooth periodic profiles have identically zero a₂ only if constant. At cosine phase zero the order-ω^(−1) micromotion vanishes. Its next term at phase zero is iε[A,B]/ω²+iε²[A,C]/(8ω²), found by integrating i[K₁,A], since all other order-ω^(−1) oscillations have amplitude degree at least three. Conjugation then adds −ε[A,[A,B]]/ω²−ε²[A,[A,C]]/(8ω²), also independently reproduced by evaluating the triple Magnus integrals over one cosine period. The extra quadratic principal coefficient is −C''/2; the total is 5(g'')²−g'g''' and integrates to 6∫(g'')². In either convention the obstruction is formal only. No propagator-level convergence, bound, or invalidation of the exact geometric mapping is inferred.
